 "rationale": "A 1.57 V swing needs a rail-to-rail common-source output stage, which rules out the 5T, folded-cascode and telescopic options. Current budget: Iref 10 uA, tail 10 uA, stage 2 about 36 uA, so power is about 101 uW. GBW is gm1/(2*pi*Cc), with gm1 about 90 uS and Cc about 0.65 pF. Rz cancels the second pole (gm7/CL), so PM is set by the Rz*C1 pole. The input pair is long-L and large-area to keep flicker noise low."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak-ish inversion, efficient, big area -> low 1/f)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (10e-6, 6e-6, 14e-6),   # tail current
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + output device gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror / output L
    "I2":    (36e-6, 25e-6, 40e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmidn": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (0.65e-12, 0.35e-12, 1.2e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),        # Rz scale vs. pole-cancelling value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Itail, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]
    I1 = Itail / 2

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode) and its mirrored output device
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.0 + 0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    # second stage PMOS CS: same gm/Id and L as the mirror, so Vsg matches (low systematic offset)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: ibias diode, tail, output sink (all same gm/Id and L)
    m9 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.6)
    m9 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=m9.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I2, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgd * 1.0
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + (CL + C1) / Cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("M9", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # compensation
    n.R("Rz", "x", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + CL * C1 + CL * Cc))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / gm7 - Rz)) if abs(1.0 / gm7 - Rz) > 1e-9 else 1e18
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    ph = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    # z<0 here means LHP zero (Rz > 1/gm7): adds phase
    ph += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) if z < 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z)))
    power = vdd * (Iref + Itail + I2)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.04
    # common mode: tail output resistance
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * (1.0 / m5.gds) * m3.gm / 1.0 * 1.0 / max(m3.gm, 1e-12) * (m3.gm / (m3.gds + m1.gds)) / max(1.0, 1.0))
    cmrr = min(cmrr, db(A1) + db(2 * m3.gm / m5.gds))
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 6.0  # rough: dominant supply path through M7 Vsg
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    sv_th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    sv_fl = (220e-9 * 0.6) ** 2  # flicker placeholder (large-area pair)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv_th + sv_fl)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": ph, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "noise_1k": noise}
